keyWhy.ko: 핵심은 «아기 고래가 낡은 그물에 걸렸다(문제)» 와 «유리가 아기 고래를 구했다(해결)» 입니다. 초록색 문장이 정답이에요.
keyWhy.en: The key ideas are the problem (the baby whale is stuck in an old net) and the solution (Yuri saves the baby whale). The green sentences are the answers.

boxes.a: Captain Yuri, a baby whale, and its mother
A baby whale is stuck in an old fishing net.
Yuri cuts the net, and the baby whale swims to its mother.

sumHowto.ko: 먼저 위 세 칸을 보고, 빈칸에 알맞은 단어를 고르세요.
sumHowto.en: Look at the three boxes, then choose the right word for each blank.

words: Captain Yuri is diving in the deep blue sea.
a very big animal that lives in the sea
The whale is stuck in an old fishing net.
not able to move or get out
Yuri cuts the net, little by little.
a big web of strings for catching fish
able to move and go anywhere
helped someone get out of danger

qs.q: Why does the baby whale sing a sad song?
qs.qko: 아기 고래는 왜 슬픈 노래를 부르나요?
opts: It is stuck in an old fishing net.
It wants to play with Yuri.
evs: The whale is stuck in an old fishing net.
Captain Yuri is diving in the deep blue sea.
The two whales jump out of the water. Splash!
why: 아기 고래가 낡은 그물에 걸려 있어요. 그래서 슬픈 노래를 불러요.
The baby whale is stuck in an old fishing net, so it sings a sad song.

qs.q: "The whale is free!" What does "free" mean here?
opts: It does not cost any money.
It is very tired and sleepy.
It can swim away from the net.
evs: She hears a sad, low song.
Captain Yuri is diving in the deep blue sea.
why: 그물에서 풀려난 고래가 엄마에게 헤엄쳐 가요. 여기서 «free» 는 갇혀 있지 않고 마음대로 움직일 수 있다는 뜻이에요.
The whale swims to its mother. Here, "free" means it can move and swim away from the net.

qs.q: How do the whales say thank you to Yuri?
opts: They give Yuri a big fish.
They jump out of the water together.
They sing a sad, low song.
evs: She hears a sad, low song.
The two whales jump out of the water. Splash!
Yuri saved the baby whale, and the whales said thank you.
Yuri cuts the net, little by little.
why: 두 고래가 물 위로 뛰어오르는 것이 바로 고맙다는 인사였어요. 두 문장을 이어야 알 수 있어요.
The two whales jump out of the water, and that is how they say thank you. You need both sentences.

ends: Yuri and her friends clean old nets out of the sea.
유리와 친구들이 바다에서 낡은 그물을 치운다.
The baby whale comes back to visit Yuri's boat.
아기 고래가 유리의 배를 찾아 다시 놀러 온다.

write.src: “Let’s <u>clean up the old nets</u> before <u>more whales get stuck</u>.”
write.howtoKo: 예문을 틀로 삼아, 빈칸 두 곳을 «함께 할 일 + 그보다 나중에 일어날 일» 로 바꿔 영어로 써 보세요.
write.howtoEn: Use the example as a pattern. Write what to do together and what happens later in English.
write.moreKo: 한 걸음 더: «before» 뒤에 «누가 + 무엇을» 넣어 써 보세요. (예: before Dad comes home)
write.moreEn: One more step: after «before», write who + what. (e.g. before Dad comes home)

img.cover: In bright blue water full of sunbeams, Captain Yuri, a woman with a short black bob, a bright yellow diving suit and round blue goggles, floats with open arms as a small gray baby whale with a white belly, free from an old green fishing net drifting away below, swims happily around her, and a huge gray mother whale swims close.

scenes.1: Under the water, a small gray baby whale with a white belly is caught in an old green fishing net with sad eyes, and Captain Yuri, a woman with a short black bob, a bright yellow diving suit and round blue goggles, swims up holding a pair of rescue scissors and begins to snip the net piece by piece.
scenes.2: On the sunny sea, a huge gray mother whale and a small gray baby whale with a white belly leap out of the water side by side with a big splash, as Captain Yuri, a woman with a short black bob, a bright yellow diving suit and round blue goggles, waves happily from a small white boat.

alt.1: Yuri cuts the net around the baby whale.
alt.2: The two whales jump out of the sea near Yuri's boat.
alt.cover: Captain Yuri swims with the free baby whale and its mother.
